data.one_liner: Advanced error handler and logger package for Flutter and Dart applications
data.what_it_does: Talker provides a comprehensive error handling and logging ecosystem for Flutter and Dart. It allows developers to log custom messages, catch and handle exceptions, monitor application history, display logs on-screen, and share error reports.
use_when: You need detailed on-device and console logging during development
You want an in-app UI screen to inspect application logs and history
You need structured logging for HTTP, BLoC, Riverpod, or gRPC
avoid_when: You only need a simple, lightweight print replacement with zero extra features
You require an off-device production-only crash reporting service without local UI needs
strengths: Rich ecosystem of plugins for Dio, BLoC, Riverpod, HTTP, and gRPC
Built-in UI screen (TalkerScreen) for inspecting logs directly inside the app
Customizable log formats, colors, and observers
weaknesses: Adds multiple package dependencies depending on which integrations are used
Can increase app bundle size if extensive history tracking is retained in production
data.setup_notes: Simply add talker or talker_flutter to pubspec.yaml and instantiate Talker().

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose logger if you just want a simple, highly customizable pretty printer for console logs without UI screens or advanced error reporting workflows.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose sentry if you want dedicated cloud-based error tracking and performance monitoring rather than an on-device log viewer.
